title: I Took the Roommate Utility Chat Through Three Leases Before I Dropped the Screenshots

parts.text: Our roommate chat had a rule: equal utilities on the first. I Venmo'd $180 for June. July came and their envelope to me was $40 with a note that said "wifi energy." I was twenty-four, holding the June screenshot. I asked in the chat for the equal-split rule they had pinned. They unpinned it. I said nothing and waited for the next lease.
parts.cliffhanger_hint: There is another lease in September and I still have the June screenshot.

social.video_title: The pinned equal-split rule vanished after June — Part 1/3
social.description: 180 versus wifi energy, an unpinned rule. September is coming. Would you have unpinned first?

parts.text: September's lease was in my name. They sent a playlist of apology songs. I sent a thank-you and a calendar invite labeled RECEIPTS after the third lease, which was November. I was still twenty-four, still screenshotting. November they asked me to Venmo $180 again because "you care about optics." I cared about a pin. I dropped the June, September, and the unpinned rule into the chat and muted.
parts.cliffhanger_hint: The chat is reading three timestamps; nobody has typed.

social.video_title: They asked me to Venmo 180 after a playlist — Part 2/3
social.description: My lease got a playlist. November wanted my 180. The timestamps are in the chat. Do they type?

parts.text: Sam typed first: "optics is a word." Jordan Venmo'd $140 with the memo catch up. I unmuted long enough to pin a new rule: SCREENSHOTS ARE THE PIN. We still split. The envelopes match or the chat gets a PDF. Wifi energy is now an $180 topping. I keep the mute nearby like a bill that actually fits.

social.video_title: Screenshots are the new pinned split — Part 3/3
social.description: Catch-up Venmo, a new pin, matching envelopes. Was a playlist ever 180?
